facts.about: Bajaj Finance is mainly engaged in the business of lending. BFL has a diversified lending portfolio across retail, SME and commercial customers with a significant presence in urban and rural India. It also accepts public and corporate deposits and offers variety of financial services products to its customers.(Source : 202003 Annual Report Page No:124)

business.summary: Bajaj Finance Ltd. is a financial services company engaged in lending activities, including home loans, loan against property, lease rental discounting, developer financing, and unsecured loans.

scorecard.promised: Added 15-17M new customers in FY27, later updated to 18-20M.
scorecard.delivered: FY27 is ongoing; pending full-year delivery.
scorecard.evidence: Guidance revised upwards from 15-17M in Q4 FY26 (c2g0) to 18-20M in Q2 FY27 (c0g1).

scorecard.promised: Deliver full-year revenue growth between 26% and 27% in FY27.
scorecard.delivered: Sep 2026 revenue grew 22.8% YoY to ₹24,546 crore.
scorecard.evidence: Q2 FY27 YoY revenue growth stands at 22.8%, needing acceleration to reach 26%-27% for FY27.

scorecard.promised: Deliver 20% to 24% AUM growth in FY27.
scorecard.delivered: FY27 is ongoing; pending full-year delivery.
scorecard.evidence: Quarterly revenue grew 18.6% in Jun 2026 and 22.8% in Sep 2026 toward the annual target.

scorecard.promised: Improve opex-to-NTI by 25 to 40 basis points in FY27.
scorecard.delivered: Financing margin held at 36% in Jun 2026 and Sep 2026.
scorecard.evidence: Margin stood at 36% in Sep 2026 quarter versus 33% full-year FY26, pending full-year FY27 opex data.

scorecard.promised: Deliver ₹11,000 crore to ₹12,000 crore via AI voice/text bots in FY27.
scorecard.delivered: FY27 ongoing; target requires ~₹3,000 cr quarterly run-rate.
scorecard.evidence: Full-year target of ₹11,000-₹12,000 cr requires sustained momentum across FY27 quarters.

narrative.scoreline: Management has progressively upgraded customer addition guidance while maintaining steady revenue momentum, though key efficiency metrics remain to be verified at full-year FY27.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: The capital raise is driven by growth story and long-term ROA/ROE goals without urgent liquidity pressure.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Borrowings stand at ₹5.02L cr with net worth at ₹1.23L cr and negative CFO due to balance sheet expansion.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: MSME growth momentum returns between Q2 and Q3 FY27.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Revenue growth accelerated from 18.6% in Jun 2026 (Q1 FY27) to 22.8% in Sep 2026 (Q2 FY27).

bull: Revenue growth re-accelerated to 22.8% YoY in Sep 2026 quarter reaching ₹24,546 crore.
Quarterly net profit rose to ₹6,367 crore in Q2 FY27 with stable 36% financing margins.
Gross NPA remains well controlled at 1.06% and Net NPA at 0.42% as of Sep 2026.
bear: CFO remains negative at -₹65,790 crore in FY26 due to lending balance sheet expansion.
Management raised customer addition target, putting pressure on credit underwriting quality.
Capital raise rationale faces analyst pushback given high borrowing base of ₹5.02L crore.
watch: Check if Q3 FY27 revenue growth meets the promised 26%-27% full-year target range.

claims.claim: The increase in Stage 2 assets is transient, caused by short-tenor schemes which have since been discontinued.
claims.quote: It's a transient movement for the quarter is really what we see it to be and don't see any impact on credit costs.

claims.claim: The capital raise is driven by India's growth story and the company's need to maintain long-term ROA/ROE goals.
claims.quote: The Board's decision of raising additional capital is principally driven by mainly growth story of India and of the company and its subsidiaries.

claims.claim: The company is actively reducing 3PL (three-point leverage) in its origination process to manage risk.
claims.quote: We have brought that down from 14% to 7% in terms of origination my mandate to the team is to bring that down to 3.5% in the 6 months' time.

claims.claim: Macroeconomic overlays are created to build resilience against cyclicality and external economic factors.
claims.quote: The fundamental reason for creating overlay, let me articulate it not because we see stress building. I want us to remember always that this is bullet proofing of the business.

claims.claim: MSME business should come back into growth momentum by Q3.
claims.quote: It should come back into growth momentum by Q3 or so.

claims.claim: We remain quite optimistic about the credit cost outlook for FY '27.
claims.quote: And we, in general, remain quite optimistic about the credit cost outlook for FY '27.

claims.claim: We are doubling down on Fin AI transformation and expanding the AI unit from 230 to 400 people.
claims.quote: We're doubling down on Fin AI transformation. We're expanding the AI unit from 230 to 400 people.

claims.claim: We are in no hurry to raise capital; BHFL dilution is the first protocol.
claims.quote: We still have to dilute BHFL. We are at 86.7%. We will go down to 75%, while we have time and we are in no hurry.

claims.claim: MSME growth should return to double-digits or company momentum between Q2 and Q3 of FY27.
claims.quote: We expect that it should come back to double-digit growth or the company growth momentum between Q2 and Q3 of FY27.

claims.claim: Gold loan portfolio is expected to cross 5% of total AUM by FY27.
claims.quote: We foresee gold loan portfolio to probably cross 5-odd percent of total AUM by FY27.

claims.claim: FY27 will be the busiest year for FinAI transformation with 600-plus autonomous agents to be deployed.
claims.quote: In FY27, we expect to deploy 600-plus autonomous agents and across operations, DMS, HR, technology and risk.

risks.text: Proposed material related party transactions with subsidiary Bajaj Housing Finance Limited up to 18,152 crore.
Significant management judgment in determining impairment loss allowance based on expected credit loss model.
High reliance on complex IT systems and controls for financial reporting and transaction processing.
